target_customer: Data teams at companies that want AI agents to query warehouses and BI tools reliably; open source users first, ktx Cloud buyers for governance
problem: Data agents fail because metric definitions are scattered and ungoverned, and semantic layer projects take months. Kaelio builds the context layer automatically from the warehouse, BI tools and docs.
business_model: Open source core (ktx, Apache 2.0) with a paid hosted ktx Cloud and a managed Data Agent product
product_category: Context layer and semantic layer for data agents

founders.name: Luca Martial
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a data scientist and NLP engineer with enterprise data and AI safety expertise; no employers or school named.

founders.name: Andrey Avtomonov
previous_startups: Described by YC as a repeat AI safety founder; names not given
founders.background_notes: Software and AI engineer at CERN and Dataiku per the YC page.

competitors.name: AtScale
competitors.what: Universal semantic layer that integrated with Snowflake Cortex Analyst so AI generated SQL matches business definitions

competitors.name: Cube
competitors.what: Semantic data layer with new integrations announced for AI use

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatically inferring and governing metric definitions across warehouses, BI tools and docs, and making agent answers deterministic, is hard but built on standard LLM and SQL tooling by a team of two founders with CERN and Dataiku engineering backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: The core is open source under Apache 2.0, so the code is copyable; stickiness would come from governed definitions that teams build up in the context layer, and the company says it is reached through CLI and MCP.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: As of the batch, semantic layer vendors were already adding agent and Cortex Analyst integrations. Later comparisons describe native warehouse layers and dbt offering MCP servers for agents. No acquisition or shutdown found.

market_need_then: Companies were rolling out text to SQL agents in 2025 and hit inconsistent metric definitions. Semantic layer vendors reported momentum in February 2025, which shows spend and demand for governed definitions.

branding.domain_note: kaelio.com is the company site; no purchase story found.

identity.logo: Lowercase ktx wordmark for the product, per the company site
identity.mascot_or_character: A mascot with light and dark versions appears on the site
identity.visual_style: Developer oriented, product names in bold within body copy
identity.voice_and_tone: Short declarative lines such as Trusted answer. Same logic every time.

branding.brand_signature: The ktx open source product name and mascot
branding.community_and_virality: ktx is on GitHub and npm as @kaelio/ktx per a search summary; no evidence found of merch or fan activity.

brand_strength.rationale: Two brand names (Kaelio company, ktx product) and no press on the brand itself found; the open source name ktx may carry developer awareness but no source shows it.

outcome_analysis: Kaelio is active and early. It joined YC in Spring 2025 and open sourced ktx, aiming at the gap where data agents lack governed context. Semantic layer vendors and warehouse native layers were already moving toward agents, so the key risk is incumbents absorbing the wedge. No outcome search result showed an acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
notes: Unverified funding: a yespress profile says the YC era seed was led by Rebel Fund, and everydev shows an estimated $500,000 standard YC check. No company announcement or second outlet confirms an amount, so no round is recorded. Education not found. YC page lists batch as Spring 2025 (a search summary said P25 or X25 in other sources). Outcome search found no news at all about the company.
